successCriteria.note: Sprint 1 (DM-130 c5): Source control first, last tab remembered per folder, works on folders not set up for Dark Mechanicus; sprint 2 DM-140 c17 subfolder/root handling.
Sprint 1 e2 (diffs, chosen files, trash, undo) plus sprint 3 e3 (selected lines committed exactly, LF and CRLF). Sprint 4: a commit or undo can no longer interleave with a sync (DM-401).
Sprint 1 e3: History lists commits with files and diffs; DM-218 unpushed markers only with a remote; View on GitHub for GitHub repos (DM-153).
Sprint 2 e1 / DM-140 c1–c2: Use my GitHub CLI login imports the gh token, @login in the footer, sign-out; token only safeStorage-encrypted, never in renderer, logs, argv or error text (DM-141 tests).
Sprint 2 e2: ahead/behind and progress; account credentials via a helper scoped to https://github.com when signed in, machine credentials otherwise; stall timeout (DM-395).

Sprint 2 e3/e4: create, switch (stash/bring), rename, delete, merge; conflicts from merge, pull and stash restore resolved, aborted or committed; rebase-merges sides fixed in sprint 3. Sprint 4: stash-restore 'Use mine' keeps the stashed work (DM-403).
Sprint 3 e1: clone from the account list or a URL into the chosen folder with progress and cancel, opens tracked.
Sprint 3 e2: current branch's PR shown, Create pull request opens the compare page, open PRs including forks checked out.

outcome.summary: Source control is complete on source-control (sprint increments 5a5a03c, 3dcbb97, d956b0b, 49fc5c2): every tracked folder opens on a GitHub Desktop-style Git view with changes and diffs, file and line commits, discard to trash, undo, history, GitHub sign-in through the machine's GitHub CLI login, fetch/pull/push with progress, branches and stashes, merge conflicts, clone and pull requests. Sprint 4 closed the final review's findings (per-repository operation lock with compare-and-swap undo, confined working diff, stash/Windows/fork-ref edge fixes). All eight success criteria are met. Merging source-control into main is the person's step; main has moved since (Kanban and Terminal chats epics) and the merge will conflict in shared files.

title: Source control: a GitHub Desktop-style Git view in every folder
